summary: Trinity wakes up on the Main Deck after Neo sends her out of the Matrix first. As Tank unplugs her, she notices his charred wounds. He claims he is fine, but when she asks about Dozer, his face tightens, prompting her to take him into her arms.

what_changes.before: Unaware of the physical state of the crew on the ship
what_changes.after: Aware that Tank is injured and Dozer is likely gone

what_changes.before: Injured but concealing the extent of the harm
what_changes.after: Injured and emotionally affected by Dozer's status

event_hint.one_line: Trinity wakes to find Tank injured and Dozer missing.
